name: Muzammil Patel
title: Test Automation Engineer
summary: Test Automation Engineer experienced in manual and automated testing of healthcare desktop and web applications for Philips and GE Healthcare. Builds reusable automation with C#, Python, Java, FlaUI, Selenium, and TestComplete.

projects.name: IGT Azurion
bullets: Developed reusable WPF automation components for UI navigation and synchronization.
Implemented expected-versus-actual procedure validation across system configurations.
Built screenshot, OCR, XML/JSON, and failure-investigation helpers.

projects.name: Elever
bullets: Designed manual test cases for functional, regression, UI, validation, boundary, and negative testing.
Translated user stories and business requirement documents into detailed test scenarios and cases.
Automated healthcare web workflows using Java and Selenium, with reusable step definitions and feature files.
Participated in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to support Agile delivery.

projects.name: CT-Incisive
bullets: Designed automated web application tests using Python and TestComplete, with execution on CT physical machines.
Validated complete user workflows through end-to-end, functional, regression, and sanity testing across multiple builds.
Created common custom methods and parameterized tests, reducing automation maintenance by 40%.
Implemented BDD with Cucumber and Gherkin; built reusable step definitions and feature files to improve maintainability and scalability.
Executed manual and automated test cases and batches on CT physical machines; analyzed reports, resolved script issues, and maintained stability.
Worked with developers and QA teams to investigate defects, and collaborated regularly with clients to develop test cases.
Mentored junior team members in Java and Cucumber test automation and shared practices for consistent quality.
